headline: AI products are driving global goods trade, which is forecast to grow 4.6% this year despite tariffs.
score_reason: Forecast and trade-share figures from one report, read through a summary; pool score 6 kept.
importance_line: It matters most to exporters and to economies that depend on trade, since AI hardware now drives most of the growth, though the 4.6% is a forecast and the shares rest on one report's use of WTO and OECD data.
summary: The Economic Times reports, citing a DHL-Stern report, that global goods trade is projected to grow 4.6% this year, driven mainly by demand for AI products despite tariffs and geopolitical tensions. AI-enabling goods made up 42% of all merchandise trade growth last year and nearly 76% in the first quarter of 2026, according to the report, which cites WTO and OECD data.
notes: Bloomberg original blocked (403). Read on The Economic Times, which summarises the DHL-Stern report (WTO and OECD data). Credit follows the chain: ET names the DHL-Stern report as the source of the figures. Headline wording is ours.
